scope.help: Only data in the selected domain is inspected and managed.
scope.invalid: Domain not found or not accessible. Select another domain.
scope.denied: System administrator authority is not available.
scope.loadFailed: Unable to load the domain inventory.
inventory.title: Domains
inventory.description: Create Keystone domains and manage user/project isolation boundaries. Existing accounts are not moved.
form.name: Name
users.createScope: The new user will be created in domain {name}.
monitor.title: Domain observations
monitor.notOnline: Valid sessions are not online users. Recent activity represents observed requests only.
monitor.resourceHelp: CPU, memory and storage quantities are provisioned resources, not live CPU or memory load. They differ from summed per-project quota limits. Denied, unsupported and partial metrics are not zero.
monitor.requestHelp: Only backend requests attributed to the selected domain token are counted, not pre-authentication, browser or complete native-service traffic.
monitor.activityHelp: Retained Afterglow activity grouped by UTC hour, not complete cloud activity or current presence.
managers.title: Domain manager delegation
managers.help: Grant native manager directly in this user’s domain. Existing admin grants are view/revoke only. This is not system administration; changes revoke the target user’s existing sessions.
managers.empty: No direct domain manager roles. Inspect group/inherited authority in the permissions list above.
managers.failed: Unable to inspect or change domain manager roles.
securityPolicy.authority: Only users with a native admin role assignment on system:all are system administrators ({count}).
securityPolicy.noAdmins: There are no native system:all administrators. Administrator access is blocked.
credentials.chooseUser: Select a user in this domain
coverage.failureHistory: Complete login failure history is not collected; failures include retained observations only.
coverage.activity: Retained Afterglow audit history, not all native service activity.
coverage.online: Valid sessions and recent observations do not establish online presence.
coverage.limit: Retained activity exceeds the observation limit; totals are unknown and timelines are partial.
coverage.sessions: Session indexes or domain metadata are incomplete; absent indexes do not prove zero sessions.
coverage.resources: Some resource metrics are unavailable, unsupported or partial, not zero.
coverage.requests: Only token-attributed backend requests retained in the observation window are included.
coverage.unattributed: Some older user sessions have no domain metadata and are excluded from this domain’s valid-session count.
systemGrant.partial: Only part of the selected domain’s user list is loaded. Load more before treating search results as complete.
credentials.rollbackFailed: The credential was created, but rollback revocation failed. It may still be active. Review the list and revoke it if needed before creating another credential.
